capability.name: AIF Thermal Cooling
capability.description: Validates thermal cooling metadata and connection points for AIF cooling equipment (CDU, CRAH).

requirements.name: nominal-cooling-capacity
requirements.message: Cooling equipment must have aif:spec:nominalCoolingCapacity attribute.

requirements.name: thermal-cooling-connection-points
requirements.message: Cooling equipment with piping connections must have corresponding connection point prims.
